notes.title: New Game Content - Version 1.3.0 Update Now Available
notes.content:
A brand new update is now available for our Tower Defense game. This brings about a new Map called "Hot Rod Racer" that has 2 Bases following a race track while the evil empire tries to take you down. This brings the total Maps in the game up to 25! This update also contains UI improvements for Steam Deck players.

[list]
[*]New Map: Hot Rod Racer
[*]UI Improvements for Steam Deck users, including larger menu buttons, Base, Bots & Spot sizes increased for better accessibility.
[*]New Gamepad Cursor icon updated & improved
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273850/457bf7fb292f4fd649a3f6c7236d835cea4b06ff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273850/d4d39dbdfa93fc426f0088aff1b27cf0709e9ebe.jpg[/img]


Have you had a chance to check out the upcoming spin off called ZaciSa: Idle Defense that is coming later in 2025?

This is a Tower Defense x Idle Clicker game set inside the Crayon Empire. Let the game build out your bases, upgrade your colorful forces and attack all oncoming enemy forces. Or take charge and control your destiny and fortify your defenses. As the game levels up and enemies get stronger, you will be rewarded new weapon choices and abilities.

Be sure to wishlist!

notes.title: New Game Content - Version 1.2.0 Update Now Available

notes.title: Now Available!
notes.content:
After 3 long months of hard work, not to mention 9 years worth of previous history with this game, our Tower Defense game is now available on Steam!

Previously found on the Nintendo Wii U eShop, this vastly improved version includes not only new Maps, but new Tower Defense Weapons, new Music & new Menu/UI system. As you can tell from the graphics, our graphics are all hand made with actual crayons! 

[b]Future Plans[/b]

As was with the original title on the Nintendo Wii U eShop, I plan to support this game a good bit over the next few years. So you can expect not only improvement and bug fixes (of course), but also new Maps. I already have a few ideas on some new Maps for you all to try out.

Here are the features of the game:
[list]
[*] Over 20 different custom Maps
[*] 5 different Game Modes: Cadet, Captain, Galactic Hero, Insanity and Endless
[*] Indie crossover: Several different maps themed to Indie games featuring elements and gameplay from those games
[*] Local Co-op: Play with multiple players to control the Drone/Railgun bots to give you an upper hand
[*] Leaderboards
[*] Achievements
[*] Unlocks: Earn your way through the game by unlocking the various Maps and Concept Art page
[/list]
